menu.event: for i = 0, msg.quests:size()-1, 1 do if msg.quests[i]:getBlockInterfaceElements():size() > 0 or msg.quests[i]:getUnblockInterfaceElements():size() > 0 then game.engineReceiver():Send( game.MsgToggleBlockHudItem( msg.quests[i]:getBlockInterfaceElements(), msg.quests[i]:getUnblockInterfaceElements()) ) end end

local blockedItems = msg.blockItems; local unblockItems = msg.unblockItems; for i=0, unblockItems:size()-1, 1 do if unblockItems[i]=="retreat_button" then element["RetreatButton"]:DoStoredScript("show") break; end end for i=0, blockedItems:size()-1, 1 do if blockedItems[i]=="retreat_button" then element["RetreatButton"]:DoStoredScript("hide") break; end end

if msg.state_ == 0 then element["InstructionText"]["Text"]("text"):SetString("BATTLE_INSTRUCTION_PLACEMENT") elseif msg.state_ == 1 then element["InstructionText"]["Text"]("text"):SetString("BATTLE_INSTRUCTION_CHOOSE_ATTACK") elseif msg.state_ == 2 then element["InstructionText"]["Text"]("text"):SetString("BATTLE_INSTRUCTION_CHOOSE_DEFEND") elseif msg.state_ == 3 then element["InstructionText"]["Text"]("text"):SetString("BATTLE_INSTRUCTION_BAD_PLACEMENT") else element["InstructionText"]["Text"]("text"):SetString("ERROR_ERROR") end
local w = element["InstructionText"]:GetComponent("Text"):size().x element["InstructionText"]["Sprite"]("width"):SetFloat(w)

textComponent.name: Text

ninesliceComponent.name: Sprite
